Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The two umpires make their way out to the middle as the Sri Lanka Women are seen in a huddle. The opening pair of Anne Bosch and Tazmin Brits stride out to the middle as well. It will be Sugandika Kumari to get proceedings underway with the ball for Sri Lanka Women.
... The Run Chase ...

South Africa Women were great with the ball, also the fielders supported their bowlers really well to keep things tight. It was all about the seamers setting up a solid platform. Shabnim Ismail and Masabata Klaas struck in the first two overs of the innings to see the opposition teetering at 2/2. Then, Nadine de Klerk ran riot with the ball and recorded his best figures in a T20I match of (4-1-7-3). There were some exceptional catches taken on the field. The fielding pack was able to put the opposition under tremendous pressure which also resulted in a couple of run outs. It was a complete team performance by South Africa Women. They will certainly back their batter to get over the line and ends their campaign on a high. Sri Lanka Women though need a miracle to take home the victory with them. To find out how things pan out, do join us for the second essay.

No one really could get going with the blade for Sri Lanka Women. They started their innings by giving away a wicket on the very first delivery and since then, no two batters could stitch a healthy stand at the crease. They started losing wickets in heaps which was the cause of their downfall. It was only Chamari Athapaththu who could get a double-digit score in this innings.

Oh no! Certainly a day to forget for Sri Lanka Women. They have posted their lowest total in T20Is, only getting 46 on the board before getting bowled out. It was a complete performance by South Africa Women with the ball and they will back themselves to chase this low target.

OUT! RUN OUT! That's it, Sri Lanka Women have been bundled out for their lowest ever T20I score! This is tossed up from Nonkululeko Mlaba and outside off. Oshadi Ranasinghe looks to reverse sweep but misses and the ball goes off the keeper's pad towards leg gully. The batters look for one but there's a bit of indecision out in the middle. In the end, Oshadi has to hurry. The keeper Sinalo Jafta picks up the ball and throws it back to the bowler who whips off the bails. Sri Lanka Women finish with 46/10!
On middle and leg, turned to mid-wicket.
Around off, this is pushed towards covers.
Fuller, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera tries to block it inside the line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Outside off, pushed to point.
Inoka Ranaweera is the last batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! A very soft dismissal for Sugandika Kumari and Chloe Tryon has her first wicket of the tournament. Tossed up, on middle and Kumari looks to work it leg side with the spin. The ball holds a bit in the surface and the leading edge is found. The ball lobs up to the left of the bowler. Tryon takes a couple of steps that way and pouches it safely. Just one wicket away now Sri Lanka Women from being bowled out for a very low score.
Starts off with a shortish delivery down leg, Oshadi Ranasinghe goes on the back foot and works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Change. Chloe Tryon comes into the attack now.
At the stumps, tucked away to mid-wicket.
On the pads, nudged away towards square leg for one.

An appeal from behind the sticks for LBW but no one else is interested. This is on a length and around middle and leg, Oshadi Ranasinghe goes across to sweep it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. The review is not taken but on replay it seems very close.
Around off, nudged away towards point.

TWO BYES! Oshadi Ranasinghe tries to get funky now. Around off, Oshadi attempts the reverse sweep but misses. The keeper too spills it and the ball goes towards fine leg. The batters get a couple of byes.
Nicely floated up, full and outside off. Oshadi Ranasinghe looks to drive but gets beaten past the outside edge.

A low full toss, outside off. Kumari is unable to make the most of it. She pushes it gently towards mid off. A top-order batter could've dealt with it better. Nadine de Klerk ends her spell of 4 overs and records her best figures in T20Is with 4-1-7-3. Incredible stat.
It is full, on middle. Oshadi Ranasinghe looks to whip it across the line. It goes to square leg off the inner half and they cross for one.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket.
It is full, on middle and leg. Oshadi Ranasinghe makes room and drives it towards mid off.
Nadine de Klerk serves it on a length, on middle and leg. Oshadi Ranasinghe defends it into the deck.
Length ball, on off. Oshadi Ranasinghe pushes it to mid off.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.
Tossed up, outside off. Kumari tries to chase it but misses.
Sugandika Kumari is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nonkululeko Mlaba gets herself into the wicket's column. South Africa Women have been exceptional in the field so far and they continue their good work. It is short, outside off. Malsha Shehani stays back and looks to cut it away. It takes the top edge and lobs behind backward point. Laura Wolvaardt there turns around and takes an exceptional diving catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Laura Wolvaardt b Nonkululeko Mlaba

Commentary.Commentary: On off, defended out.
This is sliding down leg. Malsha Shehani tries to sweep it away but misses. The ball passes over her pads. Hence the umpire does not signal a wide.
Floated and full, on off. Shehani defends it out to point.
A good recovery by Ismail after getting hit for a boundary in the over. She gives away only 5 runs. It is a length ball, on off. Oshadi Ranasinghe blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Malsha Shehani punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Length, on off, blocked.
Full length, angled in, on middle and leg. Malsha Shehani tries to defend it out and manages to get an inside edge.
FOUR! Top shot! A length ball, outside off. Malsha Shehani plays it late and guides it past point for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off and shaping away a touch. Malsha Shehani looks to drive at it but misses.
Fuller, on the pads. Oshadi Ranasinghe nudges it off the inside edge towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Oshadi Ranasinghe is in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! Sri Lanka Women lose their seventh wicket now. It is tossed up, on off. Malsha Shehani pushes it towards backward point and scampers across for a quick single. Laura Wolvaardt charges towards the ball, picks it up quickly and throws it to the keeper. Meanwhile, Ama Kanchana tries to put in a late dive to get safely inside the crease but Sinalo Jafta is quick to take the bails off. This third umpire is involved and concludes that Ama Kanchana is short here.
Is that a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays confirm that the bails are off before the bat gets inside the popping crease.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Malsha Shehani defends it out.
Full, on off, pushed out to safety.
This is flatter, on middle and leg, hurries onto the batter. Malsha Shehani looks to pull it away. It lobs off the outside edge to the left of the keeper. It lands safely.
Mlaba starts with a short one, on off. Ama Kanchana pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Change. Nonkululeko Mlaba comes into the attack now.
On off, this is blocked out by Shehani.
WIDE! Good length, well outside off and shaping further away. Wide called.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full and outside off, Malsha Shehani strokes it away through cover-point and the ball races away into the fence.
Around off, this is blocked out by Shehani.
Length, outside off, Malsha Shehani looks to play at it but misses.

LEG BYE! Length ball, around middle and angling in. Ama Kanchana shuffles across the stumps a bit and tries to flick it away. The ball goes off the pads and towards backward square leg as the batters cross over. Not much of an appeal from the fielding team though.
Around off, pushed towards covers.

And again! Masabata Klaas almost repeats the trick but the batter escapes this time around. This is short and around off, Malsha Shehani looks to pull but the ball hit the higher part of the bat and pops up around silly point, no one is over there though.
Malsha Shehani is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Oh dear, this might well be the last nail in the coffin for Sri Lanka. This is banged in short over leg stump from Klaas. Athapaththu comes down the track and looks to release a bit of pressure by muscling it away leg side. Athapaththu gets hurried on and the ball goes off the splice of the bat to the left of the bowler. Klaas shifts quickly to her left and dives that way to take an excellent catch. South Africa Women completely in control here.
Half an appeal for the LBW from the bowler but it is turned down. This is on a good length, around leg and angling across. Chamari Athapaththu gets squared up and gets pinged high on the pads.
Banged in short and around the hips. This is helped on its way down to fine leg for a single.
A touch fuller and angling into middle and leg, Ama Kanchana nudges it towards mid-wicket.
This is on a shorter length, over middle and leg, Athapaththu tucks it away 'round the corner for one.
Change. Masabata Klaas (2-0-5-1) is back into the attack now.
This is angled into the pads, Ama Kanchana manages to work it away past square leg and picks up a couple of runs.
Around the top of off, Ama Kanchana solidly keeps it out on the off side.
Length again, around middle and leg, Athapaththu gets an inside edge towards square leg and scampers through for a run.
Length ball, on off, Athapaththu blocks it out.
FOUR! Up and over! Pitched up, around off, Chamari Athapaththu is able to free her arms this time as she thumps it over mid off and collects a boundary.
Full and straight, firmly driven towards mid off.
Uppish but safe! This is on a fuller length and angling into the pads. Ama Kanchana has a push at it and ends up chipping it just in front of the fielder at short mid on.
Full and wide, shaping away a bit. Ama Kanchana looks for the booming cover drive but misses it completely.
A touch fuller and around off, defended back towards the bowler.
Ama Kanchana is the new batter.

OUT! TIMBER! Nadine de Klerk is on fire out there! This is full and around off, the ball just nips back in sharply off the surface. Kavisha Dilhari plants her front foot forward and looks to drive on the up but is beaten by the seam. The ball takes a slight inside edge before shattering the off stump. Sri Lanka Women have lost half their side now and de Klerk has her third wicket.
Length, close to the off pole and this is tapped towards point.
Very full and on off, Chamari Athapaththu drives it through mid on and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Glorious from Kavisha Dilhari! Just a touch overpitched and around off, Dilhari presses forward and drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
Length ball, on off, this is defended out by Dilhari.
This is a bit fuller and around middle, Dilhari punches it towards mid on.
Around off, Chamari Athapaththu caresses it through covers for a single.
Full and on off. Chamari Athapaththu pushes it to the off side.
Around off, defended out.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Nadine de Klerk strikes twice in her first over and Sri Lanka Women in a huge spot of bother here. This is on middle, Nilakshi de Silva looks to come down the track and power it back but ends up completely mistiming it back towards the bowler. De Klerk takes a simple return catch and de Silva is sent back for a low score. Kavisha Dilhari is the next batter in.
Around the top of off, blocked out by de Silva.
Play and a miss! De Klerk goes full and wide again, inviting the drive. Nilakshi de Silva does go for it but misses.
Fuller in length and around off, this is pushed towards covers.
A length ball, around off, de Silva looks to drive but misses.
Nilakshi de Silva is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! A brilliant diving effort from Mignon du Preez and Anushka Sanjeewani has to depart! This is full and wide from Nadine de Klerk to start with. Anushka is well forward and tries to have a thrash at it. Anushka has to reach out for it and ends up mistiming it uppishly towards covers. Mignon du Preez over there dives forward to her left and grabs it with both hands. South Africa Women have three wickets now.
Commentary.Howout: c Mignon du Preez b Nadine de Klerk

Commentary.Commentary: Nadine de Klerk is into the attack now.
An impressive over by Shabnim Ismail. Just two runs off it. Chamari Athapaththu defends this length delivery watchfully.
Fuller, on off, defended out.
On off, pushed to covers.

We saw everything in this delivery. It starts with a great bit of fielding, followed up with a mix-up between the batters and ends up with an overthrow. Length ball, on off. Chamari Athapaththu punches it to the left of point. The fielder there dives to that side and make a sharp stop. The batters call for one, but do no commit at first. Although, they make it safely in the end. There is a direct-hit as well at the striker's end but it deflects out which allows them to sneak one more run. Two taken.
Length ball, outside off, angled across, Chamari Athapaththu stays back and punches it to covers. Not in the gap though.
Length and on off. Chamari Athapaththu defends it out watchfully.
It is full, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani reaches out and dabs it to the fielder at point. An excellent over by Klaas comes to an end.
Fuller, on the pads, Anushka Sanjeewani helps it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Masabata Klaas spills this one way outside the tramline wide of off. Anushka Sanjeewani tries to fetch it but misses. Wided.
Fuller, wide of off. Anushka Sanjeewani pushes it to covers.
Full length, on off. Anushka Sanjeewani pushes it gently back to the bowler.
Much fuller, outside off, nipping in off the deck. Anushka Sanjeewani looks to drive it away but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Length, on off, defended out.
Fuller, on off. Chamari Athapaththu pushes it to covers.

An appeal for lbw but turned down. The South African skipper thinks it is close and takes the review. Coming to the delivery, it is a length ball, on middle and leg. Chamari Athapaththu stays back and tries to block it out. She misses and gets rapped on the pads. The player appeals but the umpire shows no interest. They take the review. The UltraEdge is unable to get conclusive evidence if it hits the bat or pad first and hence the third umpire decides to stay with the on-field decision of not out.
Fraction short, outside off, angling away. Chamari Athapaththu comes down the track but keeps her bat to herself.
FOUR! Well played! This should ease some pressure. It is a length ball, outside off. Chamari Athapaththu stands tall and slaps it through covers for a cracking boundary.
A length ball, around off, it nips in off the deck. Chamari Athapaththu tries to block it out but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Length ball, on off, defended to covers.
Length ball, on top of off. Anushka Sanjeewani defends it into the deck.
Length ball, on the pads, Chamari Athapaththu flicks it to fine leg for one.
Length ball, on off, pushed out.

EDGY start for Anushka Sanjeewani. Full length, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani looks to drive it through the line but only manages to outside edge it towards third man. It lands safely they take one.
Anushka Sanjeewani comes in at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Sri Lanka Women in a spot here. Masabata Klaas strikes in her very first over. A good-length ball, wide outside off, angled away from the left-hander. Harshitha Madavi stays back and tries to cut it away. It takes a thick outside edge and goes towards the keeper. Sinalo Jafta takes yet another solid catch behind the sticks. South Africa Women are running the show with the ball here.
Commentary.Howout: c Sinalo Jafta b Masabata Klaas

Commentary.Commentary: Klaas delivers it full, wide outside off, angling away. Harshitha Madavi swings wild at it but misses.
Masabata Klaas to bowl from the opposite end.
Excellecnt start by Shabnim Ismail. a run and a wicket off it. This one is full, on off. Chamari Athapaththu looks to drive it away on her front foot but gets an inside edge on her pads.
Full length, on off. Chamari Athapaththu pushes it to point on her front foot.
Nicely bowled! A length ball pitching on off and angling away from the left-hander. Chamari Athapaththu leaves it alone. Shabnim Ismail continues to ask the right questions.
Full length, on leg stump. Chamari Athapaththu flicks it to mid-wicket.

Ismail finds the edge yet again but not any fielder this time. It is a length ball, outside off. Harshitha Madavi looks to drive it away. It goes to third man off the outside edge. They take one. Sri Lanka Women are off the mark.
Harshitha Madavi is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shabnim Ismail strikes on her very first delivery. It is a full-length delivery, angled across the left-hander. Hasini Perera tries to poke it away but only manages to get a thick outside edge. Sinalo Jafta takes a sharp catch behind the sticks. Sri Lanka Women on the back foot straightaway.
Commentary.Howout: c Sinalo Jafta b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: We are ready for play! The umpires and players are out in the middle. Hasini Perera and Chamari Athapaththu are all set to open the innings for Sri Lanka Women. Shabnim Ismail has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's go...

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Chamari Athapaththu (C), Hasini Perera, Harshitha Madavi, Kavisha Dilhari, Nilakshi de Silva, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Ama Kanchana, Malsha Shehani (In for Vishmi Gunaratne), Oshadi Ranasinghe, Sugandika Kumari and Inoka Ranaweera.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Tazmin Brits, Anne Bosch, Mignon du Preez, Laura Wolvaardt, Sune Luus (C), Chloe Tryon, Nadine de Klerk, Sinalo Jafta (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Masabata Klaas (In for Ayabonga Khaka) and Nonkululeko Mlaba.
TOSS - South Africa Women have won the toss and they will have a BOWL first.

It is the opposite for Sri Lanka Women as they do have variety in the bowling and have a couple of real wicket-taking options but against top-class batters, they haven't been able to take wickets at regular intervals. Their batting though is an area of concern and the lack of batters who can find the fence with regularity does mean that they find it really difficult to get big scores. Which team will end their campaign on a positive note? We'll find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.
